title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“拿我弟兄们的性命当儿戏？”听见了沈建武的话，杨成立马将王大年喊了过来。“大年，除了站岗放哨的弟兄以外，把所有的弟兄都叫到这里来。”“是，大当家的。”听到了杨成的命令。王大年没有丝毫的犹豫，带着手底下的兄弟走出了黑虎堂。没一会，除去站岗放哨的十几人。黑风寨的三百号人齐聚黑虎堂。当看到杨成将所有黑风寨的弟兄们召集到一起。沈建武也是一愣。只见杨成并没有关注沈建武的表情，而是对着黑虎堂内的三百弟兄们说道。“这是黑山县游击队的沈队长。”“他这一次是过来报信，说是有两支倭军中队奔着我们黑虎山来了。”“想要离开的，我也绝不会阻拦你们。”“但是我丑话说在前面。”“谁要后面给我临阵脱逃，那我就请他吃上一颗花生米。”“现在想走的，一会可以跟着沈队长一起撤离。”杨成话音落下，只见黑虎堂三百多人。没有一个人挪动脚步，打算离开。看到这一幕，杨成很是满意。于是对着黑虎堂内的众人接着说道。“这两支倭军部队，有四百支步枪。”“有轻机枪！”“有重机枪！”“甚至还有迫击炮！”“我就问你们。”“怕还是不怕？”杨成的话掷地有声，铿锵有力。“不怕！”在杨成发话之后，回应杨成的是齐刷刷的不怕两字。响彻了整个黑虎堂。每个人在喊出这句话的时候，眼神中都是涌现出一股视死如归的神情。黑风寨众人的回应，也使得沈建武暗自心惊。先不说黑风寨这帮人的装备怎么样，单论这帮人的精气神来讲。绝对是一支战力凶悍的铁军啊。真不知道杨成到底是怎么训练的，能将一支散兵游勇给训练成这样。

不过想到，杨成竟然不愿意撤退。沈建武的内心更加焦躁。这样的一支铁军，只要能够保存力量。假以时日，再装备上一些不错的枪支。那绝对是能让倭军闻风丧胆的部队。而眼下，就算这支队伍气势再强。在手中无枪的情况下，面对倭军。那简直和送死无异。沈建武刚想继续发声劝杨成撤退。却又被杨成给直接打断。“再过不久，倭军就要逼上我黑虎山了。”“我问你们。”“我们退还是不退？”杨成继续发声道。“不退！”回应杨成的，依旧是三百号人斩钉截铁的回答。“既然不退，那便死战。”杨成举起手中从倭军手中缴获的王八盒子，对着天上连开数枪。紧接着，整个黑虎堂响起了此起彼伏的声浪。“战！”“战！”“战！”当看到这一幕，沈建武的脸色煞白。他知道，黑风寨这帮人应该是铁了心要跟杨成一同死战到底了。对于即将发生的一切，沈建武十分的痛心。“王大年，送客！”没等沈建武再说些什么。杨成直接给王大年下了命令。“杨成，你会后悔的。”很快，心有不甘的沈建武几人就被王大年给带去了后山。沈建武纵然心有不甘，但还是只得离去。因为再多停留的话，只要倭军一到。他们也注定要折在这黑虎山。沈建武可不想白白送命，自己的根据地李家庄内还有一百多名自己的弟兄。等着自己带领他们杀鬼子呢。将沈建武送下山之后。
content_en:
"Are you making fun of the lives of my brothers?" After hearing Shen Jianwu's words, Yang Chengli immediately called Wang Danian over."On New Year's Eve, except for the brothers who are standing guard, call all the brothers here." "Yes, the boss." Hearing Yang Cheng's order.Without any hesitation, Wang Danian led his brothers out of the Black Tiger Hall.After a while, a dozen people standing guard were removed.Three hundred people from Black Wind Village gathered at Black Tiger Hall.When he saw Yang Cheng calling all the brothers from Heifeng Village together.Shen Jianwu was also stunned.I saw that Yang Cheng did not pay attention to Shen Jianwu's expression, but said to the three hundred brothers in the Black Tiger Hall."This is Captain Shen of the Heishan County guerrillas." "He came here this time to report that two Japanese squadrons were coming to our Black Tiger Mountain." "If you want to leave, I will never stop you." "But I said ugly things.Say it from the front.""If anyone wants to escape from the battlefield, I will treat him to a peanut." "If you want to leave now, you can follow Captain Shen to evacuate later." After Yang Cheng finished speaking, there were more than 300 people in Black Tiger Hall.No one moved to leave.Seeing this scene, Yang Cheng was very satisfied.So he continued to speak to everyone in the Black Tiger Hall."These two Japanese troops have four hundred rifles." "There are light machine guns!" "There are heavy machine guns!" "There are even mortars!" "Let me ask you." "Are you afraid or not?" Yang Cheng's words were loud and powerful."Not afraid!" After Yang Cheng spoke, the words "not afraid" were all repeated in Yang Cheng's response.It resounded throughout the Black Tiger Hall.When everyone shouted this sentence, there was a look of death in their eyes.The response of everyone in Heifeng Village also made Shen Jianwu secretly frightened.Let’s not talk about the equipment of the Black Wind Village group, but let’s talk about the spirit of this group of people.It is definitely a ferocious iron army.I really don't know how Yang Cheng trained a group of stragglers to be like this.

But thinking about it, Yang Cheng was unwilling to retreat.Shen Jianwu felt even more anxious.As long as such an iron army can preserve its strength.In time, equip yourself with some nice guns.That was definitely a force that would scare the Japanese army.And right now, no matter how strong this team is.Face the Japanese army without a gun in your hand.That would be tantamount to committing suicide.Shen Jianwu just wanted to continue to speak out to persuade Yang Cheng to retreat.But he was directly interrupted by Yang Cheng."It won't be long before the Japanese army forces them to invade Black Tiger Mountain." "Let me ask you." "Should we retreat or not?" Yang Cheng continued."Don't retreat!" Yang Cheng's response was still the decisive answer from No. 300 people."If you don't retreat, then fight to the death." Yang Cheng raised the tortoise box he captured from the Japanese army and fired several shots into the sky.Immediately afterwards, the entire Black Tiger Hall sounded one after another."Fight!" "Fight!" "Fight!" When seeing this scene, Shen Jianwu's face turned pale.He knew that the people in Heifeng Village were determined to fight to the end with Yang Cheng.Shen Jianwu was very sad about what was about to happen."Wang Danian, see you off!" Shen Jianwu didn't wait to say anything else.Yang Cheng gave Wang Danian direct orders."Yang Cheng, you will regret it." Soon, the unwilling Shen Jianwu and others were taken to the back mountain by Wang Danian.Even though Shen Jianwu was unwilling, he still had to leave.Because if we stay any longer, the Japanese army will arrive.They are also destined to end up in Black Tiger Mountain.Shen Jianwu didn't want to die in vain. There were more than a hundred of his brothers in his base of Lijiazhuang.Waiting for me to lead them to kill the Japanese.After sending Shen Jianwu down the mountain.
